ownRead.statement:
## v0.3.1 — 2026-10-07: Relation to existing work

**changeId:** `RRG-2026-10-07-V031-RELATED-WORK`
**category:** wording (related-work explanation and literature registration; no definition-core or evidence-status change).
**Prior edition/hash:** RRG v0.3 — author-clarified edition, 2026-10-06; inventory seal `dd38bd32095925941cf0c18199052767747e59c14d40ef298f900a52cab352b1`. Exact per-file hashes and manifest hash are in the preserved predecessor registration.
**Preserved edition:** `research/history/repository-current-v0.3-2026-10-07/`; all 24 members preserve exact v0.3 bytes. The loadable predecessor registration, presentation and decision evidence are preserved in `docs/evidence/source-revision-v0.3.1/predecessor-root/`.
**Affected files:** 01_world_explanation.md, 02_scientific_framework.md, README.md, sources.json, CHANGELOG.md, CURRENT_MANIFEST.md and SOURCE_AUTHORITY.md. No source is renamed or removed. `00_LOCKED_CORE.md`, 03–08, change-control, existing evidence cases, foundations and checks remain unchanged.
**Affected claims:** explanatory context for H03, H06, H08, H11–H13, H17, H24–H25, H28 and O1–O2/O7/O9. Existing claim IDs, statements and evidence statuses are unchanged. Exact affected website entry IDs are listed in the linked machine transaction.
**Problem:** existing related-work passages explain individual connections but do not offer a single readable comparison of RRG with the seven selected bodies of work. Readers can confuse shared ideas with a demonstrated new mechanism.
**Before/after meaning:** existing synergetics, autocatalytic-set and thermodynamic discussions are retained and cross-referenced. New 02 §17 gives each work's core idea, shared ground and proposed difference; 01 §16 and README point to it. RRG proposes one cycle joining formation, spreading and change of the background, with resonance-fit as the proposed rule for what connects and lasts. This addition is not yet supported by evidence distinguishing it from these theories. No claim of scientific priority or proven novelty is introduced.
**Rationale/support:** compare only widely known core ideas, the existing Haken/Kauffman discussion and five supplied bibliographic records verified 7 October 2026 (Claude). Assembly theory is briefly marked as actively debated. Bibliographic identity is not verification of findings or evidence for universal RRG.
**Permission basis/task scope:** Vasyl Hryha's approved 7 October 2026 task: theory v0.3.1 first, then four website drafts for review, under R4 §§0.3/4.5. This author-directed revision grants no new acceptance, commit, push, deployment or licence.
**Dependents:** source register, historical registration, exact source hashes/excerpts, edition metadata and source-label-map edition update coherently through the existing registration approach. Website BIB-0094–0098 register the new literature; BIB-0004/0009/0010 remain unchanged. Live website prose is unchanged. Affected website decisions become stale through fingerprints; the decision registry and issued evidence are preserved. Four proposed pages and their integration plan remain only in `docs/handoffs/extra-pages-drafts/`.
**Tests/review actually performed:** command results, draft-link check, exact preservation comparison and word counts are recorded in `docs/evidence/source-revision-v0.3.1/receipt.md`. Existing dated audit evidence remains dated predecessor evidence. Implementation stops at REVIEW_READY; independent source/website review and draft approval remain pending. No new tests or decisions are written.
**Resulting edition/hash:** RRG v0.3.1 — relation to existing work, 2026-10-07. Exact result seal/manifest hash and predecessor membership are in `config/research-source.json` and `research/publication/source-revision-v0.3.1.json`, outside the source files they hash.

### v0.3.1 acceptance link correction — 2026-10-07

Claude's acceptance fix replaces the Simon 1962 course-site PDF link with the stable JSTOR record, labelled “JSTOR record”, in 02 §17 and the matching literature registration/draft. This changes only the access destination, not the citation details, scientific meaning or evidence status. The prior unaccepted v0.3.1 candidate seal `7cdd54335fd91a7ab7df756d9dd28315de0d59da3a9b477d548cf21e083771d6` and exact inputs are preserved under `docs/evidence/source-revision-v0.3.1/simon-record-fix/before/`. The v0.3 predecessor, v0.3.1 edition name and change ID remain unchanged. Existing tooling refreshes hashes, excerpt bindings and the external result seal/transaction; actual requested checks are recorded in `docs/evidence/source-revision-v0.3.1/simon-record-fix/receipt.md`. No unrelated prose, normative core, evidence case, review decision or publication action changes.

## v0.3 — 2026-10-06: author-clarified edition

**changeId:** `RRG-2026-10-06-V03-AUTHOR-CLARIFIED`
**category:** wording (non-normative explanations and explicitly labelled extensions; no definition-core change).
**Prior edition/hash:** RRG v0.2.1 repository current; audited companion 2026-10-02; promoted 2026-10-05. Full inventory seal `caaa7691bde318f188dcecf45950b05b5c0cdcc2cff9770474522395b67c8139`; manifest SHA-256 `5a24b17fabc570d2f6586d430f08fbcb26d245bba5224a1fba746545e8c07fab`.
**Preserved edition:** `research/history/repository-current-v0.2.1-promoted-2026-10-05/`; all 24 members preserve exact predecessor bytes.

**Affected files:** README, 01_world_explanation, 02_scientific_framework, 03_mathematical_core, 04_recursive_background_generation, 08_claim_coverage, CHANGELOG, CURRENT_MANIFEST, SOURCE_AUTHORITY and sources.json. No source is renamed or removed. Normative core, change-control, optional mathematical illustrations, evidence catalogue, dated audit, foundation snapshots and check material remain byte-identical.

**Affected claims:** H01–H03, H06–H09, H13–H17, H22–H23; sharpened H24–H28 and O9; O1, O3–O4 and O7–O8 explanatory boundaries. Existing IDs remain stable. The linked transaction lists the exact source-bound website IDs affected by the changed files, without changing their evidence or review status.

**Problem:** the entry point did not lead with the name's rules. Readers could confuse chaotic motion with organized resonance, physical holding with resonance-fit, building blocks with changed conditions, or survival/reproduction with the broader evolutionary reading. The main account left stellar ancestry and fundamental-force history insufficiently explicit. The carried-forward latent-channel model could be mistaken for a decision about force origin.

**Before/after meaning:** the geometry–mode closure and conditional recursion are retained. The explanation now starts with the three name-rules, chance/noise and mutual shape/rhythm support; distinguishes forces from the proposed fit criterion and inner/outer coupling; states energy/supply/lifetime limits and separate next-step roles; corrects the enriched-material chain before our Sun; and makes survival, favourable environmental change, spread, joining, humans and possible AI explicit. Fundamental forces appearing with scale/time and the cross-scale fit/spreading/success claims remain labelled hypotheses. Complexity and propagation are not guaranteed. No new factual evidence, citation or core definition is introduced.

**Rationale/support:** clearer explanations make the proposed common organizing pattern inspectable without changing its ambition. Existing core and audited component cases provide the explanatory starting point; the broader interpretations do not inherit those cases' evidence status. Candidate examples needing published citations are listed as pending topics, without factual details or evidence cards.

**Permission basis/task scope:** Vasyl Hryha's direction of 6 October 2026 to refine the theory documents into v0.3, under R4 §§0.3 and 4.5. This is an author-directed in-scope source revision, not a new scientific approval, licence grant or publication instruction.

**Dependents:** current source registration, exact raw/excerpt bindings, edition metadata and source-label maps update together. Authored website prose stays outside this batch. Prior website decisions remain issued evidence and become stale through changed source/entry fingerprints; no decision is accepted or refreshed here. The new edition awaits separate bounded review.

**Checks/review:** actual commands, results, preservation comparisons, locked-point map and all 17 reader-question answers are recorded in `docs/evidence/source-revision-v0.3/receipt.md`. Earlier 2026-10-02 checks remain dated predecessor evidence, not v0.3 runs. Implementation stops at REVIEW_READY; independent acceptance remains pending.

**Resulting edition/hash:** RRG v0.3 — author-clarified edition, 2026-10-06. The full resulting inventory seal, manifest hash and predecessor provenance are recorded in `config/research-source.json` and the machine-readable `research/publication/source-revision-v0.3.json`, which links back to this authoritative semantic record. The inventory seal is external to the files it hashes, avoiding a circular self-hash.

### v0.3 bounded recheck amendment

The pre-recheck candidate seal `5011164c1294e7e1e38139b183173d1998761685f6327b3a2551d2c944ef51c5` is preserved in `docs/evidence/source-revision-v0.3/recheck/before/`; it was an unaccepted implementation candidate, not an issued historical release. This amendment retains the same v0.3 change ID and v0.2.1 predecessor. It restores H22’s AI-only label scope and O4’s original label, preserves the author’s “adapting to almost any place” framing with its limits, distinguishes the broad RRG resonance reading from case-specific physical resonance, separates recurrence from causal spreading, and distinguishes the repeated cycle from the stronger same-equation-family test. The resulting seal remains in the external registration/transaction record. Actual focused checks, remaining website gaps and preservation results are in `docs/evidence/source-revision-v0.3/recheck/receipt.md`. No core, empirical case, scientific approval or website prose is changed by this recheck.

### v0.3 mutual-coherence wording correction

The earlier §1 sentence in 01 implied that activity keeps an independently given shape coherent. It now states: “A physical thing is better imagined as a shape and a pattern of activity that keep each other coherent.” This resolves the one-way wording against core §3; neither shape nor rhythm comes first. The rest of §1 and all definitions/evidence remain unchanged. This author-directed correction retains the same v0.3 change ID and v0.2.1 predecessor. Pre-correction candidate seal `66b2f5834f3c537f7f8e648dfac0d067f54006ca486ddc26e1fe81db57b0e31a` and exact input bytes are preserved in `docs/evidence/source-revision-v0.3/mutual-coherence-fix/before/`. Mechanical source hashes, bindings and derivative revisions follow the correction. Resulting identity and actual current-source/revision/build/output checks are recorded in `docs/evidence/source-revision-v0.3/mutual-coherence-fix/receipt.md` and the external edition/transaction records, avoiding a circular self-hash. No acceptance decision is created here.

## Repository promotion — 2026-10-05

**Owner decision:** replace the prior active repository publication/research companion with the audited RRG v0.2.1 set from 2 October 2026.

**Promoted:** current 04–08 companions, README, source register and audit/check material. The minimal `00_LOCKED_CORE.md`, repository 01–03 foundation documents and `05_CHANGE_CONTROL.md` are carried forward unchanged.

**Archived:** the complete predecessor `RRG_CURRENT` set is preserved under `research/history/repository-current-2026-10-01/`; the exact audited v0.2.1 README/CHANGELOG before repository-specific promotion notes are preserved under `research/history/v0.2.1-audited/`.

**Qualification state:** existing website source bindings/reviews that refer to superseded 04/06/07/08 documents are stale by construction. Public qualification remains blocked until mappings are rebuilt and reviewed against this edition.


## v0.2.1 — 2026-10-02: publication/evidence audit

**Preserved:** \(R=(G,M)\), full mode definition, source-direction recursion, environment feedback, persistence, competition/coexistence, repeated effective levels, life analogy, expansion conjecture, effective-law engineering, speculative “magic,” and AI possibility.

**Changed:** proof-first priorities are now optional contributor directions. Physical formation and descriptive coarse-graining are explicit separate steps. A common abstract principle is not silently equated with an identical equation family.

**Reworked 04:** retained the long conceptual companion; corrected selected claims, repaired the malformed `\neq` equation, and replaced the duplicate old bibliography with the active evidence map.

**Rebuilt 05:** conditional mathematical illustrations replace the claimed general source proof. Corrected finite-domain spectrum, scalar/radial noise, stability interpretation, constant-intensity assumption, candidate-mode threshold, scale-growth assumption and error-bound logic. Added an explicitly limited noise-filter illustration. Nine deterministic check groups are provided.

**Rebuilt 06:** 22 primary case cards with independent labels for result type and relevance, supplied conditions, limits, source identifiers and verification depth. Three further-reading records remain separate. Added optical binding, random-light interactions, granular band replication, a slow-amplitude result and a nonresonant comparator.

**Added:** current README; 07 audit report; 08 claim/session coverage; foundation errata; `sources.json`; validation scripts/results; provenance manifest and checksums.

**Archived:** original 04–06, old README and two original numerical bundles. Foundation 01–03 snapshots remain byte-identical, in their own folder. A known mathematical display defect is recorded rather than silently changing history.

**Not performed:** external publishing or Library overwrite; autonomous monitoring; full-paper/data replication; rerun of the archived 32-cell simulation; exhaustive literature/retraction audit; independent peer review; proof of universal RRG.
